mapper.sql: SELECT h.hazard_id, h.hazard_code, h.hazard_name, h.place_type, h.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.leader, d.phone, h.related_equip_ids, h.chemical_name, h.cas_no, h.critical_qty_ton, h.actual_qty_ton, h.r_index, h.major_hazard_grade, h.dow_mf, h.combustion_heat_kj, h.map_x, h.map_y, h.on_duty_count, h.risk_level, h.physicochemical_props, h.emergency_measures, h.ppe_requirements, h.status, h.create_time FROM ehs_hazard_profile h LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON h.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ehs_hazard_profile ( hazard_code, hazard_name, place_type, dept_id, related_equip_ids, chemical_name, cas_no, critical_qty_ton, actual_qty_ton, r_index, major_hazard_grade, dow_mf, combustion_heat_kj, map_x, map_y, on_duty_count, risk_level, physicochemical_props, emergency_measures, ppe_requirements, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{hazardCode}, #{hazardName}, COALESCE(#{placeType}, 'production'), #{deptId}, COALESCE(#{relatedEquipIds}, ''), #{chemicalName}, #{casNo}, COALESCE(#{criticalQtyTon}, 0), COALESCE(#{actualQtyTon}, 0), COALESCE(#{rIndex}, 0), COALESCE(#{majorHazardGrade}, '非重大危险源'), COALESCE(#{dowMf}, 16), COALESCE(#{combustionHeatKj}, 19930), COALESCE(#{mapX}, 50), COALESCE(#{mapY}, 50), COALESCE(#{onDutyCount}, 4), COALESCE(#{riskLevel}, '较大风险'), #{physicochemicalProps}, #{emergencyMeasures}, #{ppeRequirements}, '0', COALESCE(#{createBy}, 'admin'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO ehs_emergency_drill ( drill_no, trigger_type, alert_id, hazard_id, accident_type, leak_mass_kg, wind_direction, wind_speed_ms, tnt_equivalent_kg, r1_death_m, r2_serious_m, r3_minor_m, r4_property_m, affected_equip_json, affected_staff_count, action_card_markdown, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{drillNo}, COALESCE(#{triggerType}, 'MANUAL_SIM'), #{alertId}, #{hazardId}, COALESCE(#{accidentType}, '可燃介质泄漏爆炸'), COALESCE(#{leakMassKg}, 2000), COALESCE(#{windDirection}, '东南风'), COALESCE(#{windSpeedMs}, 3.2), COALESCE(#{tntEquivalentKg}, 0), COALESCE(#{r1DeathM}, 0), COALESCE(#{r2SeriousM}, 0), COALESCE(#{r3MinorM}, 0), COALESCE(#{r4PropertyM}, 0), CAST(COALESCE(#{affectedEquipJson}, '[]') AS jsonb), COALESCE(#{affectedStaffCount}, 0), #{actionCardMarkdown}, COALESCE(#{createBy}, 'admin'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
